The '''Dwarf Gadget''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up soil in [[the Mines]] (floors 40-79).  It can also be found in [[Magma Geode]]s, [[Omni Geode]]s, and [[Artifact Trove]]s.

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].  To earn the [['Burnt Offering']] reward, you must donate a [[Rare Disc]], a Dwarf Gadget, and 11+ artifacts.

==Tailoring==
The Dwarf Gadget can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Wearable Dwarf Helm|class=inline}}.
